hypothesis: The non-finite E=288 M3 monolithic result was caused by launching only four resident clusters after confusing four MMA warps with the resident-cluster count.

fixed_inputs.product: P8 K4 procedural MCG to E4M3 with physical UE8M0/32 scales

device_fact_observed_before_plan.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition

per_arm_rule: Pass only if every output is finite, cosine to the same decoded-weight FP32 reference exceeds 0.995, and relative L2 is below 0.12.
promotion_rule: Adopt 188 for the monolithic arm only if it passes. The 4 and 64 arms are causal diagnostics and cannot be selected for quality. A passing arithmetic arm is not a speed, determinism, or end-to-end KLD claim.
preservation: Write each arm to a new immutable result path; do not overwrite or reroll failures.
